# Read the grader tail
gt = await CONTEXT.search("[grader tail]")
if gt["items"]:
    for item in gt["items"]:
        offset = item["offset"]
        text = await CONTEXT.read(offset, 3000)
        print("GRADER TAIL:")
        print(text)

print("\n\n===============\n\n")

# Also search for the grade section
grade = await CONTEXT.search("[grade]")
if grade["items"]:
    for item in grade["items"]:
        offset = item["offset"]
        text = await CONTEXT.read(offset, 2000)
        print("GRADE:")
        print(text)
